Summary: LABOR for private SEC filers: officers and directors from the issuer's own Form D related-persons list (HAS_FORM_D_OFFICER_OR_DIRECTOR), person identity scoped to the issuing filing
Description: 1) Original intent: private companies that file Form D have no Forms 3/4/5, so LABOR is empty for them; Form D states the issuer's executive officers and directors by name and role in its own filing. The Founder ratified (2026-10-12) admitting those as LABOR relationships. 2) Acceptance criteria: (a) a new ratified type HAS_FORM_D_OFFICER_OR_DIRECTOR: part = (issuer SEC CIK node, person node scoped to that issuer and the name as the filing states it); nu_id {role: OFFICER or DIRECTOR}; the person identity is explicitly NAME_SCOPED_TO_ISSUER_FILING: never matched or merged with any other entity or person, never shared with another relationship; (b) only the roles Executive Officer and Director as the Form D states them are admitted; Promoter and any other relationship are not; (c) the newest Form D of the issuer is read; the evidence carries the accession, filing date, the role and clarification as written; the relationship is 'disclosed as of' that filing and no end is inferred; (d) the producer runs only for entities resolved as SEC Form D issuers (producer identity-class contract), through the existing read, admission, store, snapshot, Analysis, MAP and History; (e) tests over real Form D documents; verified live for Databento and Integrated Biosciences; existing counts unchanged. 3) Current implementation state: ratified 2026-10-12; starting. 4) Dependencies: KRYL-1412 (Form D identity), KRYL-1411 (producer contracts). 5) Superseded: no. 6) Maps to the product model: yes (LABOR).
